description:
Activate Skyshroud Ranger by tapping it, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Skyshroud Ranger as it is a land due to Ashaya.
Repeat.
